name: kestrel-ledger
description: IndexedDB as the Shadow Fold (rho): a binary append-only ledger of signed 6-byte Primorial-Fold packets. Exhale on every state transition; inhale on boot by replaying the ledger onto the immutable DNA. The node resumes in the exact state it closed in — reconstruction byte-identical, a poisoned ledger rejected by the Ed25519 verify-before-parse gate.
